failed: {agent} could not answer this — the request to the model failed. Mention it again to retry.
timedOut: This reply never arrived. The server restarted while the agent was answering, or the model took too long. Mention it again to retry.
unknownAgent: There is no agent called “{agent}” in this workspace.
agentDisabled: {agent} is switched off for this workspace. A workspace admin can enable it in AI settings.
providerDisabled: {agent} has no AI provider configured. A workspace admin can set one up in AI settings.
notConversational: {agent} does not answer discussions — it only runs as a background pass.
modelMissing: {agent} needs a model that supports {capabilities}, and the one configured for it does not.
